title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
About the Role This is a hands-on execution role rather than a strategy or people-management role. The successful candidate will own the operating health of the outbound infrastructure, administer and continuously improve HubSpot, monitor paid media performance and spend, produce campaign and nurture copy, and deliver the weekly and monthly reporting that leadership runs the business on. The role suits a marketing operations generalist who is comfortable moving between technical configuration, data hygiene, campaign copy and performance analysis within the same day. Role & responsibilities Core Accountabilities These are the areas the role owns outright and will be measured on. 1. Email Engine & Deliverability Monitor bounce rates by sending domain against defined thresholds; investigate and pause sending on breach. Monitor spam and complaint rates across the sending estate against defined thresholds. Track per-mailbox send volumes against agreed caps and identify runaway or stalled sends. Manage warm-up ramps for mailboxes still building reputation. Rotate and rebalance sending load across mailboxes; rest or retire underperforming mailboxes. Provision new mailboxes end to end, including SPF, DKIM and DMARC configuration and custom tracking domain setup. Conduct domain reputation audits, including blacklist checks and reputation trending. Review sequence performance by campaign, tier and step to locate drop-off. 2. HubSpot Administration & RevOps Administer, configure and maintain the HubSpot platform. Design, implement and optimise sales pipelines, lead management processes and automated workflows. QA new records on sync and import; identify and resolve duplicates on domain and email. Maintain accurate lifecycle stage and lead status progression through the funnel. Enforce marketing contact governance, promoting records only at genuine engagement to control licence consumption. Monitor marketing contact volumes against the licensed ceiling. Work the data quality queue, resolving flagged, incomplete and invalid records. Maintain active, suppression and exclusion lists. Enforce naming, tagging and tier conventions on all import batches. Run workflow health checks to confirm automations fire correctly. Audit properties and fields; prune unused properties to keep the data model clean. Verify integration and connector health across the stack. Confirm source-to-revenue attribution remains intact. Troubleshoot platform issues and provide ongoing user support. Document CRM processes, standards and best practices. Partner with Sales leadership to coach and train users on effective HubSpot usage and CRM best practices. 3. Reporting & Analytics Deliver the weekly multi-channel performance report across channels and target tiers. Maintain the send-side reporting dashboards and BI layer. Review outbound platform performance dashboards. Run funnel and attribution diagnostics. Produce the monthly leadership performance pack. Produce the monthly conversion and coaching trend report. 4. Paid Media Performance Management Monitor spend pacing against budget caps and investigate anomalies. Monitor delivery health and learning-phase status across campaigns. Review landing page conversion performance and brief iterations. Reconcile spend across platforms for consolidated reporting. Run a monthly performance review by target tier and offer. 5. Content & Copy Produce net-new campaign assets as campaigns rotate. Write and refresh nurture sequence copy. Write SEO content briefs and direct the external SEO agency. Produce landing page copy variants for testing. 6. Data & Targeting Maintain suppression alignment across all data and outreach vendors. Monitor signal sources for trigger events, including RFx activity, leadership changes and M&A. Re-score the target universe as the ideal customer profile evolves. 7. Vendor & Program Management Keep exclusion lists synchronised across vendors. Resolve prospect collisions between vendors and internal channels. Manage tool renewals, seat allocation and licensing. 8. Brand & Web Governance Enforce approved terminology and positioning across all assets. Remediate legacy terminology across site navigation, footers and pages. Write page briefs and QA delivered pages with the build resource. 9. Maintain organized product data, SKU records, image URLs, catalog files, and marketplace-specific listing documentation. Plan SEO-friendly product descriptions, category content, blogs, and landing pages. Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, and organic conversions. Analyze campaign and website data to identify opportunities to reduce acquisition costs and improve return on marketing spend. Work with internal teams or agencies to improve campaign execution and creative performance. 5. Analytics, Reporting & Business Growth Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on marketplace sales, website traffic, advertising performance, SEO progress, and conversions. Monitor product-level sales, margins, pricing competitiveness, inventory availability, and promotional performance. Maintain accurate operational records and ensure timely completion of assigned activities. description:
IT Service Desk Analyst / Senior Analyst (Global Enterprise Support) Job Title: IT Service Desk Analyst / Senior IT Service Desk Analyst Department: End User Support (EUS / BCC) Location: Bangalore, India (Strictly 5 Days On-Site / Work from Office) Experience Range: 4- 9 Years Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent Work Shift: Rotational Shifts (Follow-the-Sun Global Support Model) 
 Role Overview We are seeking customer-focused, operationally driven IT Service Desk Analysts and Senior Analysts (4-9 years of experience) to join a leading global enterprise's End User Support organization in Bangalore. In this hands-on, operationally focused role, you will deliver high-quality technical support to enterprise IT users worldwide across hardware, operating systems, applications, and collaboration tools, ensuring stable, secure, and productive workplace technology experiences. Operating within a follow-the-sun global operational model, you will triage and resolve incidents, fulfill service requests, manage complex escalations, and collaborate closely with Desktop Side Support, Desktop Engineering, Infrastructure, Network, Security, and Application resolver teams across regions. Depending on your experience level, you will execute playbook-driven support tasks, drive advanced cross-domain troubleshooting, contribute to problem management/RCA, and mentor junior team members. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. End User Support & Service Desk Operations Provide day-to-day first-line and advanced technical support globally across the enterprise IT environment (hardware, operating systems, applications, and collaboration tools). Log, categorize, prioritize, triage, and resolve incidents and service requests in strict adherence to defined SLAs and operational standard operating procedures. Troubleshoot and resolve end-user issues across Windows endpoints, account unlocks, password resets, MFA guidance, Outlook/email sign-in profiles, printing/peripheral issues, standard "how-to" queries, and basic network connectivity checks (Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, proxy). Execute routine service desk activities including onboarding and offboarding administration (joiner/mover/leaver processes), mailbox and shared mailbox access, distribution list/group membership updates, Teams/channel access requests, standard software installations, and printer mappings. 
 2. Incident Management & Advanced Troubleshooting Perform structured incident triage using checklists, diagnostic scripts, logs, knowledge articles, and Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring tools (Nexthink) to validate issues and confirm impact and urgency. Act as an escalation point for complex incidents, driving thorough technical investigation, coordination across resolver groups, and timely restoration of service. Escalate issues that require deeper technical investigation via standard escalation paths, ensuring each ticket includes a complete triage package (symptoms, business impact, attempted troubleshooting steps, diagnostic logs, and user communications). Collaborate seamlessly with Desktop Side Support, Desktop Engineering, Infrastructure, Network, Security, and Application teams to resolve cross-domain incidents. Maintain clear and timely communication with end users and stakeholders, setting realistic expectations, providing regular status updates, and confirming resolution prior to ticket closure. 
 3. Service Requests, Access & Device Support Fulfill standard and repeatable catalog service requests (software provisioning, access requests, VPN setup guidance, email configuration/profile rebuilds, standard device/peripheral setup) using documented playbooks and automation where available. Support user identity, Single Sign-On (SSO), and access governance tasks in strict alignment with enterprise security policies and required approvals. Provide operational support for collaboration and productivity tooling (Microsoft 365, MS Teams, Exchange/Outlook) and common workspace peripherals (docking stations, headsets, monitors, printers). Coordinate device lifecycle activities with local Desktop Side Support teams (imaging, hardware replacements, break/fix logistics), ensuring accurate asset and ticket records. 
 4. Problem Management, Knowledge & Change Enablement Identify recurring incidents, monitor trend patterns, and contribute to Problem Management by logging symptoms, reproduction steps, workarounds, and supporting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations. Author, review, and maintain standardized knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and ticket resolution notes to improve first-contact resolution (FCR) and support repeatability. Support IT change implementation activities (operational validation, user communications, hypercare support) and ensure service desk readiness for new or modified services. Maintain meticulous ticket documentation, categorization, and reporting inputs to support service performance, auditability, and continuous operational improvement. 
 5. Operational Excellence, Queue Governance & Mentoring Manage assigned ticket workload and monitor overall queue health to meet SLAs, highlight backlog bottlenecks, and escalate systemic risks or service-impacting trends to leadership. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, including repeat contact reduction, self-service adoption, and standardizing repetitive support procedures. Participate in follow-the-sun rotational shifts and on-call operational support as required, ensuring smooth shift handovers and ticket updates. Provide operational guidance, technical coaching, and mentoring to junior analysts when needed (for senior-level profiles). 
 Technology Stack Platforms: ServiceNow (ITSM), Nexthink (DEX Solution), Moveworks (AI Chatbot) Operating Systems: Windows Desktop OS, Mobile OS (iOS / Android basic support) Productivity & Collaboration: Microsoft 365, MS Teams, Exchange / Outlook, SharePoint Endpoint & Access Tools: Remote Assistance Tools, Endpoint Management Platforms, Active Directory, SSO, MFA, VPN Solutions ITSM Processes: Incident Management, Service Request Fulfillment, Problem Management, Change Enablement Knowledge & Self-Service: Enterprise Knowledge Base, Self-Service Portals, Support Runbooks

Access & Identity Management: Proven experience supporting identity and access requests (SSO, MFA, Active Directory user administration, distribution lists, shared mailboxes) under strict security approval workflows. description:

description:

The candidate will assist in auditing gold loan transactions, verifying KYC documentation, analysing business trends, reviewing CCTV footage and ensuring compliance with established company policies and procedures. CCTV Verification: Review CCTV footage of gold loan transactions and branch operations to identify procedural deviations and ensure adherence to prescribed processes. TA Bill Verification: Verify Travel Allowance (TA) claims and supporting bills to ensure accuracy and compliance with the companys reimbursement policy. Audit Reporting: Assist in preparing audit reports, documenting observations and highlighting discrepancies to the reporting manager. Compliance & Process Adherence: Support the audit team in ensuring adherence to internal controls, operational guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. Follow-up & Corrective Actions: Coordinate with relevant teams to track audit observations and ensure timely resolution of identified discrepancies. 
 Eligibility Criteria MBA in Finance from a recognised institution. Freshers are encouraged to apply. Basic understanding of financial transactions, accounting principles and auditing concepts. Good analytical and numerical skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and basic data analysis. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies. Good communication skills and willingness to learn. Ability to work with confidential information and maintain data integrity. 
 Preferred Skills Analytical thinking and problem-solving. Accuracy in document verification and data handling. Integrity, accountability and a detail-oriented approach. Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

title: Accounts And Finance Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Accounting & Reporting Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring accurate, complete and timely recording of financial transactions in accordance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. Manage monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing, including general ledger scrutiny, balance sheet schedules, provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses and intercompany reconciliations. Prepare and review financial statements, management reports, MIS and variance analysis for senior management. Ensure timely closure of books and adherence to defined reporting timelines. Maintain robust accounting documentation, schedules, reconciliations and supporting records. Monitor accounting treatment for lending transactions, interest income, processing fees, partner commissions, operating expenses and other business transactions. 2. Treasury & Banking Operations Oversee bank reconciliations, cash and bank balances, fund flows and liquidity-related accounting. Coordinate with the Treasury team on borrowings, lender reconciliations, interest calculations, repayment schedules, loan balances and related accounting entries. Ensure accurate accounting and reconciliation of loan disbursements, customer collections, repayments, settlements and bank/payment gateway transactions. Monitor accounting of borrowing costs, accrued interest, processing charges and other financing expenses. Support preparation and review of borrowing-related statements, lender confirmations and treasury MIS. 3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Oversee timely preparation, review and filing of GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable statutory returns. Ensure accurate computation and accounting of tax provisions, deferred taxes, statutory liabilities and tax-related reconciliations, as applicable. Manage GST reconciliations, input tax credit reviews, vendor compliance and resolution of tax discrepancies. Monitor changes in applicable tax laws and ensure timely implementation of relevant compliance requirements. 4. RBI Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Coordinate preparation, validation and submission of applicable RBI returns and regulatory statements in consultation with the Compliance and Regulatory Reporting teams. Ensure consistency between regulatory submissions, accounting records, financial statements and underlying operational data. Support NBFC-specific reporting, audit requirements, regulatory inspections and information requests. Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence for regulatory reporting and compliance reviews. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address reporting discrepancies and ensure timely remediation. 5. Audit, Internal Controls & Risk Management Lead coordination for statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, concurrent audits and other applicable reviews. Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents and management responses within agreed timelines. Support due diligence, financial reviews and information requests from lenders, investors and other stakeholders. 8. Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination Lead, guide and review the work of the Finance & Accounts team, including task allocation, performance monitoring and capability development. Liaise with statutory auditors, tax consultants, banks, lenders and external service providers. Provide timely and reliable financial information to senior management for decision-making. Eligibility Criteria Education Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Experience Manager / Senior Manager: Typically 23 years of relevant post-qualification experience. Experience in an NBFC, fintech, digital lending company or BFSI organisation is preferred. Exposure to lending operations, treasury, financial reporting, regulatory compliance and audit management will be an advantage. Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of accounting standards, financial reporting, taxation and statutory compliance. Practical understanding of NBFC operations, digital lending, loan accounting and treasury processes. Experience in month-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, MIS preparation and audit management. Familiarity with applicable RBI reporting requirements and NBFC regulatory frameworks. Proficiency in MS Excel, accounting software and ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP or Tally. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and process-management skills. Ability to lead a team, manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight deadlines. Effective communication and stakeholder-management capabilities. A process-oriented mindset with a focus on automation, accuracy, governance and continuous improvement. Key Success Measures Timely and accurate monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures. Accuracy and completeness of financial statements, MIS and regulatory submissions. Timely completion of statutory filings and resolution of tax and audit observations. Effective reconciliation and closure of outstanding accounting differences. Strengthening of internal financial controls and reduction in recurring control gaps. Improved efficiency through process automation and reduced manual intervention. Effective team management and adherence to agreed service levels and reporting timelines.

Key Skills: Financial Reporting,Book Closing,Statutory Compliance,Taxation,MIS Preparation,Finance and Accounts,Statutory,Financial management

description:

This role requires a strong background in Record-to-Report (R2R) and General Ledger (GL). A key responsibility is managing work assignments, balancing team workload based on individual capacity and skill levels, and optimizing productivity. Experience: 10 to 12 years Job Type: Full-time Responsibilities Client Management Serve as a reliable and consistent point of contact for client inquiries, handling all communications (email, calls, Slack, etc.) effectively and proactively addressing queries to support the Account Manager. Prepare for client meetings, including organizing agendas, taking meeting minutes, and summarizing client meetings with action items and next steps. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including clarity in written tone, making emails simple and easy to read. Independently manage selected clients, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of services. Support strong client satisfaction through accurate and timely work delivery. Be prepared to field any client-related questions, proactively resolving issues to free up the Account Managers time. Know Your Customer: Research clients thoroughly by exploring their financials or websites - understanding their vision, mission and core values and identifying their key priorities and pain points. Ensure this understanding is incorporated into client interactions and deliverables, aligning services with their goals to provide tailored and impactful solutions. Ensure that you are proactively anticipating client needs based on their business focus and play a key role in enhancing satisfaction and trust. Financial Analysis and Reporting Conduct detailed financial analysis and review financial statements for clients, identifying trends or issues. Execute the month end close process, ensuring accurate and timely completion of reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting. Develop financial plans, forecasts, and budgets for clients in collaboration with the Account Manager. Ensure compliance with accounting standards, such as GAAP, and help clients stay updated on relevant regulations. Manage and support the 1099 tax process and other tax-related services. Audit Support Coordinate audit activities, including preparing schedules, gathering documentation, and liaising with auditors to ensure a smooth audit process. Perform a final review of all audit schedules and financial support documents prior to client or auditor review. Team Management and Development Monitor the time tracking of team members working on managed client engagements, checking their time logs at regular intervals throughout the day to ensure accuracy and proper allocation. Ensure client work is completed within the budgeted time. Conduct comprehensive workload analysis and planning, assigning deadlines for all tasks delegated within the team to provide ample review time prior to client due dates. Guide and mentor junior staff, providing training and helping them develop skills in accounting and client management. Foster team development by giving feedback on communication skills, transparency, ownership, effort, quality, and mindset during performance reviews and as needed. Identify high-potential team members and create development plans to prepare them for advanced responsibilities. Encourage cross-training among team members to ensure versatility and reduce dependency on specific individuals as well as create flexibility within the team to share workload effectively. Provide clear expectations and constructive feedback to team members on an ongoing basis. This may occur immediately after client interactions, during regular one-on-one meetings, or as situations warrant. Document outcomes of these feedback sessions. Operational Excellence Conduct research to resolve internal queries. Proactively update the Account Manager on project status. Encourage team members to identify and come up with process improvements ideas and support in implementing the best practices for improvement in quality, customer satisfaction or efficiency of the process. Maintain process documentation to reflect changes and improve team effectiveness. Take ownership of personal and team performance, ensuring accountability and results. Process Standardization: Work with the team to identify opportunities to standardize processes and workflows, ensuring consistency and efficiency across all client engagements. Supporting Team Documentation Make sure the team follows all required processes, including: Completing month-end trackers Using Canopy for project management Maintaining Service Improvement Tracker, Client Relationship Tracker Keeping client-specific documents up-to-date Attention to Management initiatives such as OKRs Check and approve step-by-step guides (SOPs) for all client work. Use existing how-to guides and resources to help the team work better. Look for ways to improve how we do accounting for clients, focusing on making things faster and more accurate. Collaboration and Teamwork Foster collaboration and teamwork within and across teams (e.g., tax specialists, auditors). Work closely with the Account Manager to ensure seamless service delivery to clients. Promote a positive and motivated work environment where every team member is valued. Foster Sutro Li company values such as transparency, collaboration, generosity, and self-discipline. Requirements Minimum Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field, MBA or CA inter preferred. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software. The successful candidate will have a strong background in GL accounting and experience working with US GAAP. AP background not required. Thorough understanding of nonprofit accounting principles added advantage. Ability to apply accounting principles and solutions to meet unique client needs and clearly articulate proposed solutions to clients' problems. Willingness to work from office or home or in hybrid model as per the requirements. Self-starter, work with minimum guidance, ability and willingness to go extra mile to meet business requirements.

Develop strategies for customer retention, business expansion, additional vehicle deployment and penetration of new transportation requirements within existing accounts. Monitor transportation performance through MIS, PL, KPI dashboards, fleet utilization, vehicle productivity, TAT, OTIF, SLA and route profitability. Ensure achievement of budgeted revenue and margins through effective pricing, route costing, commercial negotiations and cost-control initiatives. Drive route-wise and vehicle-wise profitability improvement by optimizing vehicle utilization, trip productivity, fuel consumption, manpower cost and operational expenses. Ensure effective fleet planning and deployment based on customer demand, route requirements, vehicle availability and business volumes. Monitor and improve vehicle utilization, turnaround time, trip frequency, empty running, loading/unloading time and fleet productivity. Drive optimization of fixed and variable transportation costs, including fuel, driver cost, vehicle rental/EMI, toll, maintenance, vendor cost and other operational expenses. Ensure accurate and timely transportation billing and revenue realization, including trip billing, detention, fuel escalation, additional kilometers, waiting charges and other applicable commercial components. Review and negotiate transportation rates, route pricing, fuel escalation, vehicle cost revisions, manpower revisions, contract renewals and commercial proposals to protect business profitability. Lead customer relationships at senior management level and act as the key escalation point for transportation, operational, commercial and contractual matters. Conduct regular customer reviews covering service performance, fleet requirements, route performance, cost improvement, business expansion and future transportation opportunities. Monitor and ensure compliance with SLA, TAT, OTIF, vehicle placement, fleet availability, safety and customer-specific transportation KPIs. Drive continuous improvement in transportation operations through route optimization, technology adoption, automation, GPS tracking, digital trip management and data-driven decision making. Identify opportunities for consolidation, load optimization, backhaul, multi-drop planning and reduction of empty kilometers to improve transportation profitability. Build and maintain a strong business pipeline by identifying new lanes, customers, locations and transportation solutions. Ensure effective management of transportation vendors and fleet partners, including performance, cost, availability, compliance and service quality. Lead and manage the transportation workforce, including drivers, supervisors, transport coordinators and other operational teams, ensuring productivity, discipline and service delivery. Ensure effective manpower and driver planning, deployment and productivity optimization in line with transportation volumes. Develop Managers, Transport In-charges and frontline leaders through capability building, performance management and succession planning. Review individual and team performance against KRA/KPI, establish improvement plans and ensure accountability. Handle critical IR, driver-related issues, workforce disputes and operational escalations and ensure timely resolution. Ensure compliance with SOPs, transportation processes, statutory requirements, EHS, vehicle documentation, driver compliance and customer-specific requirements. Drive a strong culture of safety, customer centricity, operational excellence, cost consciousness and continuous improvement across the transportation business. Ensure implementation of HO policies, transportation initiatives, cost-saving programs, digital initiatives and strategic business projects. Promote initiatives for fuel efficiency, reduction in carbon emissions, EV adoption, sustainable transportation and responsible fleet management. Conduct periodic Transportation Business Reviews with senior management, presenting revenue, GM, fleet utilization, route profitability, customer performance, risks, opportunities and action plans. Identify and mitigate transportation risks, including vehicle availability, driver shortage, fuel price volatility, route disruptions, customer dependency, compliance and profitability risks. Drive new transportation solutions and innovative business models, including dedicated fleet, spot transportation, milk-run, shuttle, line-haul, FTL/LTL, first-mile/last-mile and value-added transportation services, as applicable.

Role: Manage day-to-day accounting, maintain accurate financial records, coordinate payments and collections, and support financial reporting and statutory compliance across the companys business activities. Key Responsibilities Maintain books of accounts and record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries. Prepare and verify customer invoices, vendor bills, debit notes, and credit notes with supporting documents. Manage accounts payable and receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments. Reconcile bank statements, customer and vendor ledgers, and intercompany balances, where applicable. Maintain petty cash records and verify employee expense claims and reimbursements. Check purchase orders, delivery challans, goods receipt records, and invoices before processing payments. Coordinate with procurement, stores, sales, and operations teams to reconcile inventory transactions and resolve billing discrepancies. Prepare payroll inputs and support salary processing, deductions, and reimbursement calculations. Compile records and coordinate with the Chartered Accountant or tax consultant for GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory filings. Assist with monthly and annual closing, financial statements, audit schedules, and supporting documentation. Prepare periodic reports on cash flow, expenses, collections, payables, receivables, and budget variances. Maintain fixed asset records and assist with depreciation schedules. Ensure proper filing, confidentiality, and easy retrieval of financial records. Highlight payment discrepancies, overdue balances, and unusual transactions to management.

title: Chartered Accountant
description:
Role Summary This is a high-ownership role for a qualified CA with 45 years of experience who has worked across depth and breadth in the service sector as operator / auditor and is now ready to move into an operating finance role. You will be the custodian of accounting accuracy, tax compliance, and reporting discipline for the group, while working closely with the CEO's office, business teams, and external stakeholders such as banks, auditors, and consultants. The ideal candidate combines technical depth with the maturity to communicate financial matters clearly to non-finance stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Financial Reporting Ensure books of accounts are maintained accurately as per Indian GAAP, with working knowledge of Ind AS applicability and disclosures relevant to the group's evolving scale. Drive periodic (monthly/quarterly/annual) closing within defined timelines, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial statements. Prepare and review Balance Sheet reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, and schedules supporting the financial statements. Own MIS reporting timely, accurate, and insight-driven dashboards/reports for management review. Support ICFR (Internal Controls over Financial Reporting) design, documentation, testing, and remediation tracking. 2. Direct Tax Compliance Manage end-to-end TDS compliance (Salary and Non-Salary) computation, deposit, quarterly returns, and reconciliation with Form 26AS/AIS. Prepare and file Income Tax Returns (ITR) for group entities. Coordinate and manage Tax Audits (Form 3CD and annexures) with statutory/tax auditors. Handle scrutiny assessments, notices, and departmental correspondence, including preparing submissions and liaising with consultants/counsel where required. 3. Indirect Tax Compliance Own GST compliance across multiple state registrations monthly/annual return filings (GSTR-1, 3B, 9/9C), and timely reconciliations (GSTR-2B vs books, e-invoicing where applicable). Manage Input Service Distributor (ISD) compliance and cross-charge/credit distribution mechanics across states. Lead GST audits and departmental reviews; draft and coordinate responses to GST notices and queries in a timely, well-documented manner. Proactively track changes in GST law/notifications/circulars and assess impact on the business. 4. Fixed Assets & Debtors Control Maintain the Fixed Assets Register additions, disposals, capitalisation, depreciation (Companies Act and Income Tax), and periodic physical verification. Own debtors control — ageing analysis, collections follow-up coordination, provisioning for doubtful debts, and reconciliation of client/customer accounts. Work with business teams to resolve billing/collection discrepancies and tighten receivables discipline. 5. Treasury & Banking Manage day-to-day banking relationships across group entities — operations, facilities, and documentation. Monitor and ensure compliance with loan/facility covenants, and coordinate timely submission of required certifications/data to lenders. Handle Bank Guarantees — issuance, renewal, tracking of margin money/collateral, and coordination with banks and business teams on client-mandated BG requirements. Support cash flow visibility and working capital coordination with the treasury/finance team. 6. Systems, Controls & Process Improvement Work extensively in Tally, including cost centre–based accounting for entity/function/project-level visibility. Identify and drive automation opportunities in accounting, reconciliation, and reporting processes using MS Excel and other tools. Maintain documentation and audit trails consistent with best-practice control standards. 7. Team, Communication & Cross-Functional Interaction Lead and mentor a small team of accounts — reviewing work, building capability, and ensuring accountability. Act as a key liaison between Finance and other functions (Operations, HR, Procurement, Business Heads) to ensure smooth month-end processes, vendor/client account matters, and compliance data flows. Communicate clearly and confidently with statutory auditors, tax consultants, bankers, and regulatory authorities. Prepare clear, concise summaries and escalate risk areas proactively to the CFO/Controller with recommended courses of action rather than just raising issues. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Experience & Background Mandatory: Qualified Chartered Accountant with 4–5 years of post-qualification experience, either with a mid-sized corporate or a CA firm with strong statutory audit exposure in the service sector. Solid grip on Indian GAAP; working familiarity with Ind AS. Demonstrated hands-on (not just supervisory) experience in TDS, ITR filing, tax audits, and handling scrutiny/assessment matters. Practical experience with multi-state GST compliance, including ISD, reconciliations, audits, and notice handling. Experience with periodic closing, MIS, balance sheet reconciliation, ICFR, fixed assets accounting, and debtors control. Exposure to banking/treasury operations, covenant tracking, and bank guarantee management is a strong plus. Education Chartered Accountant (CA) – mandatory qualification. Key Skills & Competencies Proficient in Tally (cost centre accounting) and advanced MS Excel; an aptitude for process automation will be valued. Strong communication skills — able to explain financial/compliance matters to both finance and non-finance stakeholders. Prior experience managing or mentoring a small team, with a collaborative, cross-functional working style. High degree of ownership, integrity, and comfort operating in a compliance-first, deadline-driven environment.

title: Taxation Account Officer
description:
About Us Technocraft Ventures Limited (Formerly known as Technocraft Construction Private Limited) is a 27-year-old infrastructure company specializing in sewerage networks, sewage treatment plants, and allied water infrastructure works across India. We execute projects under national flagship programmes including AMRUT 2.0, Namami Gange, and state-level urban development missions, with operations spanning 6+ states and an annual turnover exceeding 300 crore Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Taxation Accountant with 6 to 10 years of hands-on experience in GST compliance, TDS return filing, accounting, ITC reconciliation and statutory reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Tally, Computax, Microsoft Excel, the GST Portal and the TRACES Portal. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end GST and TDS compliance, maintaining accurate tax records, reconciling ITC, preparing statutory returns and coordinating with internal departments, senior officials and tax consultants to ensure timely and accurate compliance. 
 Key responsibilities 1. GST Accounting & Compliance Record all GST-related transactions in Tally, including purchases, sales, subcontracting, expenses, capital goods, ISD, RCM and GST TDS. Maintain GST liability, electronic credit and cash ledger records. Maintain invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills and supporting documents. Prepare state-wise GST liability and payment statements, including ITC, cash payments and challans. Verify GST TDS entries uploaded by government departments and other deductors. 2. GST Return Filing Prepare and file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and ISD returns, wherever applicable. Review and process entries appearing in GSTR-2B. Prepare and file GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, wherever applicable. Ensure timely filing and accuracy of all applicable GST returns. 3. ITC Reconciliation Reconcile ITC between Tally books and GSTR-2B using Computax software. Extract accounting data from Tally and prepare Excel-based reconciliation reports. Identify missing invoices, excess or short ITC, mismatches and other discrepancies. Coordinate with the concerned SAO team for verification and finalization of ITC. Obtain necessary clarifications from DCFO, CAO and State GST Consultants, wherever required. Ensure finalized ITC is correctly considered before filing GSTR-3B. 4. Annual GST Return & Reporting Compile monthly GST and ITC data for annual reporting. Prepare consolidated data for GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C. Review discrepancies and incorporate necessary corrections before finalization. Maintain GST records and supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes. 5. TDS Compliance & Return Filing Prepare and file salary and non-salary TDS returns using Computax software, in accordance with applicable statutory requirements. Prepare TDS liability statements covering tax, interest and late fees. Prepare section-wise and service-wise TDS reports for balance sheet and statutory audit purposes. Calculate employee salary tax liability based on applicable tax regimes, slabs, deductions and rebates. Download and coordinate the distribution of applicable TDS certificates, including Form 16 and Form 16A. Prepare and file revised TDS returns, wherever required. Handle TDS defaults, notices and outstanding demands through the TRACES Portal. 6. Documentation, Audit & Coordination Maintain systematic physical and digital records of GST and TDS documents. Prepare tax statements, reconciliations, challan records and compliance reports. Coordinate with internal accounts teams, SAO teams, senior finance officials and external tax consultants. Support statutory audits and tax-related assessments. Monitor compliance deadlines and ensure timely completion of assigned responsibilities. Required Skills & Software Knowledge 
 Strong practical knowledge of GST and TDS compliance. Hands-on experience in Tally and Computax software. Expertise in GST return filing and ITC reconciliation. Working knowledge of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B, GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C. Experience with salary and non-salary TDS returns and the TRACES Portal. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and reconciliation reports. Strong analytical, documentation and coordination skills. Candidate Requirements 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in taxation, accounting and statutory compliance. Graduate or postgraduate degree in Commerce, preferably B.Com or M.Com. Proven experience in independently handling GST and TDS compliance. Ability to manage multiple compliance deadlines with accuracy. Good communication and coordination skills. Preferred Candidate: An experienced taxation professional capable of independently managing end-to-end GST and TDS compliance, reconciliation, reporting and audit support. 
 Note : Please relevant candidate contact only Vinay Kumar (Manager HR ) Phone 9870507119

title: Senior Customer Service Associate Freight Forwarding
description:
Job Description : Senior Customer Service Associate Freight Forwarding
 Location: Chennai, India
 Department: Customer Service 
 Employment Type: Full-time -Work from Office
 About Silq: Silq is a fast-growing, tech-enabled freight forwarding and quality inspection startup helping North American importers move goods reliably across APAC-US trade lanes. We are building a team that values ownership, clear communication, and customer-first thinking. With offices in Chennai, Bangalore, and Mumbai, you will work closely with global teams and have real scope to grow. 
 Role Overview 
The Senior Customer Service Associate will manage end-to-end customer service for import and export shipments across ocean freight (FCL/LCL) and air freight. The role involves coordinating shipments, maintaining customer relationships, monitoring shipment milestones, ensuring timely documentation, and working closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver excellent customer service.

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Customer Service & Client Management 
 Act as the primary point of contact for customers from booking through final delivery. Provide proactive shipment updates and respond promptly to customer enquiries, calls, and emails. Conduct customer meetings to review performance, resolve issues, and strengthen relationships. Handle customer complaints and escalations effectively. Assist the sales team with quotations, proposals, and customer follow-ups. 
 2. Freight Forwarding Operations 
 Create and manage import and export shipment jobs for FCL, LCL, and air freight. Coordinate with overseas agents, shipping lines, airlines, customs brokers, transporters, and other service providers. Monitor shipments from origin to destination and coordinate customs clearance, cargo release, cartage, and delivery. Coordinate delivery orders, transport arrangements, and shipment documentation. Identify and escalate delays, vessel rollovers, missed cut-offs, and operational issues. 
 3. Shipment Tracking & Reporting 
 Prepare and share daily shipment reports (DSR) with customers and internal teams. Track ETD, ETA, transshipment updates, and delivery milestones. Proactively communicate schedule changes, delays, and recovery plans. Maintain accurate shipment records and system updates. 
 4. Billing & Finance Coordination 
 Coordinate customer invoicing and vendor invoice processing with finance and accounts teams. Follow up on outstanding customer payments and resolve billing queries. Process payment requests for COD shipments and operational disbursements as per company procedures. Maintain invoices and supporting documents in EDOCS or equivalent systems. Resolve billing discrepancies in coordination with relevant stakeholders. 
 
 5. Digital Systems & Process Improvement 
 Use freight forwarding systems, carrier portals, CRM tools, and document management platforms. Demonstrate proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and ODEX where applicable. Maintain accurate system records and follow company SOPs. Adapt to new digital tools and processes to improve operational efficiency and customer service. 
 
 
 Qualifications & Requirements 
 Bachelors degree in any discipline from a recognised university. Additional certification or training in Freight Forwarding, Shipping, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage. Minimum 3 years of experience in freight forwarding, shipping, logistics, or supply chain operations. Experience in customer service or operations with a freight forwarder or shipping line is preferred. Good knowledge of import/export operations, FCL/LCL, air freight, BL processes, carrier cut-offs, and customs clearance coordination. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Excellent customer service, coordination, problem-solving, and organisational skills. Ability to manage multiple shipments and meet tight deadlines. Proficiency in MS Office and willingness to learn new systems. Willingness to travel locally for customer meetings when required. Immediate availability or a short notice period will be an advantage.

Key Skills: Air Freight,Freight Forwarding,Customer Service,Import Export,Ocean Freight,LCL,Documentation,Customs Clearance

title: Business Operations Specialist
description:
Business Operations Specialist Description - Job Summary 
The Business Operations Specialist supports HP Service Supply Chain Harvesting programs and operations in India and other APJ markets. The role is responsible for end-to-end operational coordination, service partner governance, performance analysis, and continuous improvement. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external service partners, the position helps optimize cost, quality, turnaround time, and operational performance while ensuring compliance with agreed KPIs and governance requirements.
 
 Responsibilities Program and Operational Management Manage end-to-end program operations to deliver agreed savings targets and operational KPIs. Coordinate moderately complex Service Supply Chain activities, including demand planning, ROI analysis, pricing, purchase order requests, delivery scheduling, and operational readiness. Track operational performance, identify gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with the relevant owners. Support the validation and approval of partner spend in accordance with established controls and timelines. Partner and Vendor Governance Govern service partner and vendor performance against agreed cost, quality, turnaround time, and service-level targets. Conduct regular performance reviews with partners, vendors, internal stakeholders, and management teams. Manage operational escalations and drive timely resolution through structured problem-solving and clear follow-up actions. Maintain positive and professional working relationships with internal teams and external partners. Performance Reporting and Data Analysis Analyze performance data, operational trends, and cost impacts to support business decisions. Prepare monthly and ad hoc KPI reports, dashboards, management slides, and business updates. Provide clear insights, recommendations, and action tracking based on data analysis. Maintain accurate and well-governed program documentation and SharePoint content. Cross-functional Collaboration and Improvement Collaborate with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams across India and APJ to achieve program objectives. Facilitate regular operational meetings, document decisions, and follow up on owners and due dates. Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical recommendations for implementation. Support project and program initiatives that improve operational efficiency, governance, and customer outcomes. 
 
 Education Experience Recommended Bachelor s degree in supply chain, Business, Logistics, Operations, or a related discipline. Above 5 years of experience in supply chain, service supply chain, business operations, or a related field. Hands-on experience in partner or vendor operations management is essential. Experience in program or project management is preferred; PMP certification is an advantage. 
 
 Knowledge Skills Good understanding of supply chain and service supply chain processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into actionable insights. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional and management stakeholders. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience preparing dashboards and management reports is preferred. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively in a complex and fast-paced environment. Positive work attitude, strong ownership, and the ability to promote teamwork and collaboration. Knowledge of ERP systems; experience with SAP S/4HANA is an advantage. Preferred Attributes Customer- and results-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail. Effective meeting facilitation, stakeholder management, and follow-through. Comfortable working across countries, functions, and cultures within the APJ region. Continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to learn new processes and systems. 
 
 Success in This Role 
Success will be demonstrated through reliable operational delivery, achievement of agreed KPIs and savings goals, effective partner governance, accurate reporting, timely issue resolution, and strong cross-functional collaboration.

title: Senior Manager & Counsel, Operations - South Asia
description:
This is an in-house attorney position providing legal support in South Asia (India, Sri Lanka, Nepal and Bangladesh) to hotels operated by Hilton as well as business partners in Operations; to business partners in various departments (including development, operations and finance) in relation to hotel estate retention, amendment, interpretation, and owner relations matters; and generally, to support the Company s wider business affairs in South Asia, including compliance with laws, deployment and implementation of Hilton policies and procedures, and other general legal support. WHY YOU LL BE A GREAT FIT You have these minimum qualifications: Law degree from a common law jurisdiction Called to the bar in a common law jurisdiction 3-5 years of post-qualification experience in private practice and/or an in-house legal role. Strong foundation in corporate and commercial law, with knowledge of legal and regulatory frameworks and exposure to multi-jurisdictional matters in South Asia. Proven experience drafting, negotiating, and managing complex commercial transactions and contracts. High standards of professional ethics, integrity, judgment, and regulatory compliance. Fluent in spoken and written English, with flexibility to collaborate across global time zones. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook It would be useful if you have: Prior exposure to hospitality or hotel operations legal work Post-qualification experience in a law firm with some prior in-house legal experience exposure to legal frameworks in multiple jurisdictions Generalist with experience in general corporate and commercial law Transaction management experience including negotiating documents to conclusion Experience working for or advising MNCs Experience in managing a pool of very demanding clients Strong commercial awareness Good management skills in a multicultural, decentralized environment Effective communication skills, both verbally and in writing Ability to work irregular hours to accommodate global time differences Excellent interpersonal skills Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture At Hilton, we don t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests - we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we re setting new standards for the future of travel. Whether you re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career - and help us make every stay a little more magical. Curious about life at Hilton Explore our Careers Blog to see why we re more than a great place to stay - we re a great place to work. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique. What your day-to-day will be like: Provide advice relating to day-to-day hotel operations. Assist in retention matters and drafting of Management Agreements and Franchise Agreements. Assist and/or oversee assistance to business partners with drafting, negotiating, or counseling on business-critical matters in a manner consistent with Hilton policies, procedures, forms and past practice and with the highest level of legal service, and/or obtaining local counsel advice where business partners have additional legal needs Provide legal support for ongoing operational matters across South Asia, including marketing, advertising, promotions, hotel operations, compliance with laws, and deployment of Hilton policies and procedures. Draft, review and, where appropriate, negotiate standard form contracts such as confidentiality agreements, services agreements and sales agreements, taking into account business requirements, legal requirements, and Hilton policies and procedures. Ensure a high standard of frontline and local backup support and implementation for other business and legal areas, including Compliance, Corporate, Brands Commercial Services, Employment and Dispute Resolution, and partnering with Legal Department colleagues in APAC, EMEA and US where needed Develop and implement legal strategies to address operational issues. Under the direction and supervision of senior attorneys, provide advice to business partners in accordance with Hilton s policies, procedures and past practices, so similar matters are handled consistently and directly. Conduct training and prepare practical guidance on areas of expertise, including how to prepare and use form contracts and how to manage recurring operational, marketing and commercial legal issues consistently. How you will collaborate with others: Partner with hotel-level and corporate business partners to provide practical legal support and frontline guidance. Collaborate with Legal Department colleagues in APAC, EMEA and the U. S. to ensure advice is aligned with Hilton policies, procedures, forms and past practice. Work directly with outside counsel, counterparties counsel, vendors and outsourced professionals as needed. What you will take ownership of: Maintain and improve standard form contracts, legal guidelines, educational tools and reference materials, including ensuring the latest approved form contracts are uploaded to the appropriate repositories and available for business partner use.

title: Branch Operations Manager
description:
Branch In-charge 
 
 Role Summary: 
The BRI is responsible for branch operations control, reporting accuracy, inventory management, sales and collection tracking, and financial discipline at the branch level. The role ensures proper coordination between the branch, MSEs, and Head Office while maintaining audit readiness.
 Daily Responsibilities 
 A. Branch Operations & Monitoring 
 Verify and submit the Branch Opening Report with confirmed attendance. Ensure smooth coordination of daily branch activities. Co-ordinate with Stores, Audit team, Billing Accounts, and HR on a regular basis for compliance. B. Activity & Performance Reporting 
 Prepare Daily Work Report : Doctor visits and follow-ups Surgeries attended I C wise coordination with operations. MSE-wise activity summary Tray movement and Tally updation. C. Petty Cash & Expense Control 
 Maintain Daily Petty Cash Report : Record and verify all expenses (tray delivery, collection, local expenses) Acknowledgement and scan copy Ensure bills/supporting documents are available Track daily cash balance and avoid discrepancies D. Surgery & Tray Management 
 Report Daily IC (Surgery) Details Maintain Daily Tray Usage Report : Trays issued and returned Implant usage tracking Surgery count (day-wise/month-wise) E. Sales & Collection Tracking 
 Update Daily Sales Report (MTD & day-wise) Track MSE target vs achievement Maintain Daily Collection Report : Record collections received Identify overdue accounts Coordinate with MSEs for priority follow-ups Collection vs target F. Payment Handling 
 Handle daily collection receipts (cash/cheque/RTGS details) Invoice vs details. Ensure timely deposit/update of collections within 24 hours. Maintain proper acknowledgements and documentation Coordinate with HO for payment confirmation and adjustments G. Closing & Compliance 
 Submit Daily Closing Report : Surgeries, collections, expenses summary Share report via WhatsApp & Mail Verify tray stock with system (DB) : Update whiteboard Share stock photo Follow up with HO for Tax Invoice processing Documentation 
 Dispatch details Acknowledgement Invoices Instrument pending with HO Bill pending details 2. Weekly Responsibilities 
 A. Planning 
 Prepare Weekly Plan Report : Doctor visit plan from MSEs Expected case targets B. Performance Review 
 Prepare Weekly MOM : Weekly target vs achievement (case & value) Hospital-wise outstanding tracking New doctor visits and conversion plans C. Collection Follow-up 
 Review the ageing of outstanding Highlight critical overdue accounts to management Ensure structured follow-up plan with MSEs CS outstanding and Instrument details 3. Monthly Responsibilities 
 A. Sales & Performance 
 Monthly Sales Report Finalized Sales Report (tray & implant details) B. Doctor & Activity Reports 
 Doctor Visit & Case Report Doctor-wise Sales Report Ensure full doctor coverage by MSEs Uncovered doctors Sponsored doctors C. Stock Management & Audit 
 Prepare Monthly Stock Report Acknowledgement of ICs replacement and invoices Conduct Monthly Physical Stock Audit : Verify trays, implants, and consumables Reconcile physical stock vs system stock Report variances immediately Ensure accountability for shortages/excess D. Collection & Receivables Tracking 
 Prepare Monthly Collection Report : Opening outstanding Current month sales Collections received Closing outstanding Perform collection reconciliation with HO records Maintain proper aging analysis and risk accounts list E. Petty Cash & Expense Control 
 Submit Monthly Petty Cash Statement : Opening balance, expenses, closing balance Bill verification and audit readiness Ensure expenses are within approved limits F. Payment & Financial Coordination 
 Ensure all collections are properly accounted for Track pending payments, approvals, and adjustments Coordinate with HO for ledger reconciliation 4. Annual / Periodic Responsibility 
 Prepare Annual Branch Performance Report : Target vs achievement (monthly & yearly) Coordinate for Expense vs revenue analysis of the branch Collection efficiency Support audits and management reviews 5. Key Control Areas (Critical Accountability) 
 Stock Accuracy Zero mismatch between physical and system stock Collections Timely follow-up and reduction in outstanding Petty Cash No misuse or unsupported expenses Payments Proper documentation and tracking Deposits All deposits to be made within 24 hours of receipt. Reporting 100% accuracy and timeliness

 About the Role: 
 We are looking for a responsible and hands-on Operations Manager to manage the day-to-day operations and administration of Plant 151 . The person will be responsible for ensuring smooth functioning of the factory, effective labour management, machine availability, maintenance, security, safety and overall plant discipline. 
 The candidate should be comfortable working on the factory floor and coordinating with workers, supervisors, maintenance teams, security personnel and management.

 1. Factory Operations

 2. Labour & Manpower Management 
 - Handle contract workers, helpers, operators and other plant manpower. - Maintain attendance, shift deployment and manpower records. - Coordinate with contractors for labour requirements. - Handle day-to-day labour-related issues and maintain discipline. - Ensure proper compliance with company rules and factory policies. 
 3. Machine & Maintenance Coordination 
 - Monitor availability and working condition of machines and equipment. - Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance. - Ensure timely reporting and resolution of machine breakdowns. - Maintain records of machine maintenance and breakdowns. - Coordinate with maintenance personnel and external service providers. 
 4. Computer & Documentation 
 - Should have good working knowledge of computers. - Proficiency in *MS Excel, Word, email and basic ERP/software systems* preferred. - Maintain daily plant reports, attendance records, maintenance records and other operational data. - Prepare regular reports for management. 
 5. Security 
 - Manage and supervise security personnel. - Ensure proper entry/exit control for employees, visitors, vehicles and materials. - Monitor CCTV and security systems. - Ensure proper material movement and gate-pass procedures. - Maintain discipline and security within the factory premises. 
 6. Factory Safety 
 - Ensure implementation of factory safety procedures. - Conduct regular checks of fire extinguishers, emergency exits, electrical safety and other safety equipment. - Ensure workers follow required PPE and safety practices. - Report and escalate safety incidents immediately. - Coordinate fire and emergency drills. - Ensure the factory remains clean, safe and compliant with company safety standards. 
 7. Housekeeping & Facility Management 
 - Supervise housekeeping and cleanliness of the plant. - Ensure toilets, common areas, production areas and external premises are properly maintained. - Coordinate basic facility requirements, repairs and utility-related issues. - Ensure proper waste disposal and overall plant hygiene. 

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 - Smooth day-to-day functioning of Plant 151. - Labour attendance and discipline. - Reduction in machine downtime through timely maintenance coordination. - Factory security and prevention of material/security incidents. - Safety compliance and zero avoidable safety incidents. - Cleanliness and housekeeping standards. - Timely submission of plant reports and records. - Effective control of plant administration and operating expenses. title: Customer Success Executive
description:
Job Title: Customer Success Executive Location: Mumbai Role: Permanent (Full-time) Open Positions: 2 Experience: 1 2 years 
 About Softlink Global: Softlink Global is Indias leading logistics-tech company, powering the supply chain ecosystem for 5,000+ enterprises across 45+ countries. For over three decades, our flagship ERP, Logi-Sys, has been at the heart of freight forwarding, logistics, warehousing, and supply chain operations worldwide. We are a deep-tech SaaS organization redefining how the logistics industry works through automation, AI-led workflows, and scalable cloud technology. Joining us means being part of one of the largest logistics software companies in Asia, built by passionate product innovators and technologists. 
 Position Overview: We are looking for a dedicated, customer-centric Customer Success Executive who will be responsible for delivering high-quality customer support, ensuring fast and effective resolution of customer queries, and building strong relationships with our Logi-Sys ERP users. Your main goal is to ensure customer satisfaction, resolve issues within defined SLAs (Service Level Agreements), and enhance the overall customer experience. You will serve as the primary point of contact for clients, guiding them through their post-purchase journey, ensuring they get maximum value from our software solutions. 
 Who We Are Looking For: Fresh graduates (1 2 year experience). Basic understanding of logistics/supply chain terms. Tech-friendly mindset with curiosity to learn software systems. Strong communication and problem-solving skills. A positive attitude and willingness to learn in a fast-paced SaaS environment. 
 1. Customer Support & Technical Issue Resolution: Handle client queries across phone, email, and chat while ensuring timely and accurate ticket resolution. Diagnose and troubleshoot issues related to the Logi-Sys ERP to minimize operational disruptions for customers and maintain detailed records of all interactions and solutions. 2. Customer Relationship Management & Value Enablement: Build strong, trust-based relationships with clients by understanding their business needs and proactively guiding them to derive maximum value from the software. Regularly engage with users, share best practices, communicate new features, and ensure a consistently positive customer experience. 3. Product Feedback Loop & Continuous Improvement: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization by sharing insights, recurring pain points, and enhancement suggestions with product and technical teams. Participate in UAT cycles, validate updates, and contribute to improving help documentation and support knowledge bases. 4. Ticket Monitoring, Follow-up & Cross-Team Coordination: Monitor open tickets, ensure clarity of communication regarding resolution timelines, and follow up until closure. Escalate complex issues to relevant teams and coordinate with cross-functional groups to ensure swift, accurate, and customer-centric outcomes. 
 Career Path & Growth: Starting your journey in Customer Success opens multiple long-term career opportunities at Softlink: Implementation Consultant – work directly with clients to deploy, configure, and optimize our ERP across their operations. Product Design / Product Analyst Team – contribute to building and improving our software by translating business needs into product features. This internship gives you exposure across tech, logistics, and product functions - helping you discover where you best fit.

About the Role We are looking for a customer-focused and organized CRM Executive to manage customer communication, track enquiries, coordinate order updates and ensure timely follow-ups throughout the customer journey. The candidate will act as a coordination link between customers and internal departments, ensuring that customer queries are addressed promptly and that order-related information is communicated accurately. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a professional approach, attention to detail and the ability to coordinate with multiple departments. 3. Key Roles and Responsibilities A. Customer Relationship Management Maintain regular communication with existing and prospective customers. Respond to customer enquiries through phone calls, emails and other communication channels. Understand customer requirements and direct enquiries to the concerned sales representative. Build positive customer relationships through timely responses and professional communication. Maintain customer contact details and interaction records. B. Enquiry Management and Follow-ups Record incoming enquiries and update their status in the CRM system or designated tracker. Follow up on pending enquiries, quotations and customer responses. Coordinate with the Sales and Business Development teams to ensure timely action on leads. Track customer interest and ensure that no enquiry remains unattended. Escalate important or urgent enquiries to the concerned sales representative or manager. C. Order Coordination Coordinate with the Sales team to obtain confirmed order details and purchase orders. Maintain records of order status, expected delivery dates and customer requirements. Follow up with Production and Dispatch regarding order progress and delivery schedules. Provide customers with accurate order-status updates after confirmation from the concerned departments. Communicate delays or changes to customers promptly, after internal confirmation. D. Customer Query and Complaint Handling Receive and record customer complaints, concerns and service requests. Coordinate with Production, Quality, Dispatch or Sales to resolve customer issues. Follow up on pending complaints until the concerned department provides a resolution. Keep customers informed about the progress of their complaints. Escalate serious complaints or unresolved matters to management. E. Coordination with Accounts Follow up with customers regarding outstanding payments as directed by the Accounts or Sales team. Coordinate with Accounts to verify payment status and share relevant updates. Assist in communicating invoice-related or payment-related queries to the concerned department. Maintain records of payment follow-ups and pending customer responses. F. CRM Data Management and Reporting Maintain accurate customer databases and contact information. Update enquiry status, customer interactions, quotations and order-related information. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports on enquiries, follow-ups, pending orders and customer complaints. Maintain proper records of customer communication and commitments. Ensure that CRM data is accurate, organized and updated on time. G. Customer Feedback and Retention Collect feedback regarding product quality, delivery and customer service. Identify recurring customer concerns and communicate them to management. Follow up with existing customers to understand their ongoing requirements. Support the Sales team in maintaining customer satisfaction and encouraging repeat business. 4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Timely response to customer enquiries. Completion of scheduled customer follow-ups. Accuracy and completeness of CRM records. Timely coordination of order-status updates. Follow-up and closure of customer complaints. Accuracy of customer and order reports. Customer satisfaction and quality of communication. 5. Educational Qualifications and Experience Educational Qualification Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration or any relevant field preferred. Experience 0–3 years of experience in CRM, customer service, client coordination or sales support. Freshers with strong communication and coordination skills may apply. Experience in manufacturing or B2B customer service will be an advantage. 6. Required Skills Good verbal and written communication skills. Professional telephone and email etiquette. Strong follow-up and coordination abilities. Customer relationship management skills. Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office and Google Sheets. Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare reports. Problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage tasks systematically. 
 7. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be organized, responsive, patient and customer-oriented. The candidate must be comfortable handling customer calls, tracking enquiries, following up on orders, coordinating with internal teams and maintaining accurate CRM records.

title: HR Executive : Work From Home : Grads : Females : Freshers : Apply Now
description:
Outpace Consulting is looking for dynamic, confident and result-driven HR Recruiters with experience in recruitment or candidate calling. 
This opportunity is ideal for individuals who enjoy interacting with people, are confident on calls, and have the ability to engage, convince and close candidates. 
 Eligibility & Requirements 
 Graduate in any stream. Minimum 3 months of experience in Recruitment / Candidate Calling. Internship or full-time job experience - both are considered. Strong communication skills in Hindi with basic conversational English. Confident and comfortable with extensive calling and candidate interaction. Good interpersonal, convincing and follow-up skills. Target-oriented and result-driven approach. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Comfortable working with daily calling and hiring targets. Own laptop and stable internet connection are mandatory. 
 Who Are We Looking For? 
 Enjoys talking to and interacting with people. Has a natural flair for calling and candidate engagement. Can confidently explain opportunities and handle candidate objections. Is proactive, disciplined and self-driven. Can take ownership of assigned hiring requirements. Is comfortable working in a performance-driven environment. Is serious about building a long-term career in recruitment. 
 Role Overview 
As an HR Recruiter, you will manage the recruitment cycle from candidate sourcing and screening to interview coordination, follow-ups, selection and joining closure across multiple hiring requirements. 
 A. Candidate Sourcing & Screening 
 Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, social media, WhatsApp groups, references and other relevant channels. Understand Job Descriptions and hiring requirements. Screen candidates based on experience, eligibility and role requirements. Assess candidates' communication skills and overall suitability. Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline. 
 B. Candidate Calling & Engagement 
 Connect with shortlisted candidates through outbound calls. Explain the job profile, salary, location, shifts, eligibility and selection process. Understand candidate expectations and career requirements. Handle basic queries and objections professionally. Generate candidate interest and drive them towards interviews. 
 C. Interview Coordination & Closure 
 Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews. Maintain regular follow-ups before interviews. Ensure strong interview show-up rates. Track candidate progress through different interview stages. Follow up with selected candidates until joining. Focus on improving selection-to-joining conversion. 
 D. Candidate Management 
 Build professional relationships with candidates. Keep candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process. Provide timely interview and selection updates. Handle candidate dropouts and follow-up requirements. Maintain an organized pipeline of active candidates. 
 E. MIS & Performance Reporting 
 Maintain daily recruitment trackers and MIS. Track calls, screenings, lineups, interviews, selections and joinings. Share daily performance updates with the Team Lead. Work towards assigned recruitment targets and KPIs. 
 Why Join Outpace Consulting? 
 100% Work From Home flexibility. Performance-driven growth opportunities. Hands-on exposure to live recruitment. Opportunity to work across multiple hiring requirements. Strong exposure to candidate sourcing, calling and closure. Fast-paced and learning-oriented work environment. Opportunity to develop practical recruitment and candidate-management skills. 
 This Role Is For You If... 
 You enjoy calling, interacting with people, convincing candidates and achieving hiring targets - and want to build a serious career in recruitment. 
 How to Apply 
 Please apply through Naukri.com. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple orders and customer queries efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Resolve customer concerns primarily related to delivery, logistics, order status, and fulfilment. Provide timely and professional responses to customers. Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve customer issues. 
 4. Order Monitoring & Cancellation Regularly monitor order status from order placement to fulfilment. Identify orders delayed due to logistics or operational issues. Process order cancellations due to stock unavailability or non-serviceable pincodes . Ensure customers are appropriately informed about cancellations and order updates. Maintain proper records of cancelled and pending orders. 
 5. Data Management & Communication Maintain daily call reports and customer interaction records. Update customer address changes accurately in Shopify. Send email communication for order confirmations, cancellations, and relevant updates . Maintain proper documentation of customer and order-related information. Ensure accurate and timely data entry across systems. 
 Required Skills 
 13 years of experience in Customer Support, Customer Service, D2C Operations, E-commerce Operations, or Order Management . Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets . Basic understanding of Shopify or other e-commerce platforms. Experience with customer support/chat platforms is preferred. Ability to handle calls, chats, emails, and operational tasks simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good problem-solving and coordination skills.
